counter_semantics.executions: integer count of adapter Execute attempts; planning or validation before the adapter is 0
counter_semantics.audit_count: integer count of immutable invocation audit records written by the runtime
counter_semantics.cached: boolean indicating whether the returned value came from the principal-scoped cache

tools.name: deployment_manifest_lookup
tools.result_contract: fixed current release, Git SHA, deployment mode and rollback target

tools.name: service_health_snapshot
tools.result_contract: bounded live/ready status with dependency details

tools.name: official_document_search
tools.network_boundary: fixed official document mirror; arbitrary URL input is prohibited

tools.name: incident_resolution_confirm
tools.result_contract: optimistic-lock state transition plus immutable audit record
